findings.description: Guard default-denies the documented PR-Codex Bash flow. Bash classifier permits only commands whose raw string begins with an allowlist regex; multi-line if/then, VAR=$(...), heredoc body writes, and BODY_FILE=$(node ... pr-body --action write ...) fall through to default-deny. With the hook active in the plugin install path, pr.md as written cannot complete its own gate. Self-application meta-defect. File: plugins/mccp/scripts/hooks/pr-phase-guard.js:142-147. Recommendation: Replace head-token regex with Node wrapper commands (preferred) or a conservative shell parser. Deferred to v0-2-8-task-2-6-1-followup.plan.md#F10 — MUST land before v0.2.8 publish (Task 2.6.4 plugin.json bump). Current dev worktree hook NOT in plugin install path so self-application threat dormant in this PR.

Bash allowlist permits mutating shell constructs. BLOCK regex catches only narrow spaced > redirection; allowlist permits echo, awk, find, cat. echo x>file, echo x | tee file, awk system(), find -exec each bypass the BLOCK while satisfying the ALLOW. Review-only invariant violated before finalizer detects worktree change. File: plugins/mccp/scripts/hooks/pr-phase-guard.js:63-83. Recommendation: deny shell metacharacters, redirects, pipes, command substitutions, find -exec, exec-capable interpreters by default. Bundled into followup F7 (SR R1 reclassified MEDIUM→HIGH); R2 reinforces with specific mutating-constructs catalog.

Ownership token stored as readable runtime secret. Raw ownership_token (crypto.randomUUID) written into .claude/state/pr-phase.lock in plaintext; pr.md exports the same token into child Codex/heartbeat process environment. With the guard's read-allowlist (cat/head/awk on text files), the token is not a meaningful secret inside the review subphase. File: plugins/mccp/scripts/lib/pr-phase-lock.js:304-309. Recommendation: store sha256(token) or HMAC in lock file; compare hashes on exit/heartbeat. Don't export raw token to child env — use sealed file under .git/mccp/tmp/ with restrictive mode, deleted after read. Block direct reads of pr-phase.lock while guard is active. Deferred to v0-2-8-task-2-6-1-followup.plan.md#F11 — adjacent to F5 (mode 0o600), distinct concern.
